name: cloud-v2
description: MentraOS cloud rewrite. Local JS miniapp SDK backend, horizontally scalable, three packages (core / runtime / proxy).

scripts.mentra:dev: doppler run --project cloud-v2 --config dev_aws -- env MENTRA_CORE_URL=https://core.dev.us-west-2.mentraglass.com MENTRA_CONSOLE_URL=https://console2.dev.mentraglass.com bun packages/cli/src/index.ts
scripts.mentra:staging: doppler run --project cloud-v2 --config staging -- env MENTRA_CORE_URL=https://core.staging.us-west-2.mentraglass.com MENTRA_CONSOLE_URL=https://console2.staging.mentraglass.com bun packages/cli/src/index.ts
scripts.mentra:prod: doppler run --project cloud-v2 --config prod -- env MENTRA_CORE_URL=https://core.mentraglass.com MENTRA_CONSOLE_URL=https://console2.mentraglass.com bun packages/cli/src/index.ts
